measurement.logical_bytes: Each distinct absolute file path counted once; overlapping roots do not add bytes.
measurement.unique_file_bytes: Each available (device, inode) identity counted once; not allocated disk space.
measurement.duplicate_content_bytes_after_hardlinks: Content redundancy among distinct file objects; not proven removable bytes.
measurement.links: Symbolic links and Windows reparse points are reported and not followed or counted.
measurement.root_totals: Inclusive; overlapping roots share files. Use scope_totals or totals for union size.
measurement.consistency: File size, identity and timestamps checked before/after hashing and at end; no filesystem snapshot lock.
